## Notes

Mojang Studios, Markus Persson; first public alpha 2009-05-17; full release 2011-11-18; PC, consoles, mobile; procedural voxel world with biomes; survival mode with health and hunger; 20-minute day-night cycle with night mobs; redstone logic; villager trading; influences Infiniminer, Dwarf Fortress, RollerCoaster Tycoon; 400 million+ sold.
